query:
WITH next_wake AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM owner_wakes
            WHERE owner_id = $1
            ORDER BY created_at, id
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            LIMIT 1
        )
        DELETE FROM owner_wakes ow
        USING next_wake nw
        WHERE ow.id = nw.id
        RETURNING ow.journey_id, ow.timer_id
